ei.title: Practice 02 — 전시회 부스 설치 작업 지연을 해결하기 위한 즉각적인 대책 요구
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본2

fullPassage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, (A)[criticized / recommended] your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no (B)[delay / progress] on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work (C)[completed / canceled] one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① recommended — progress — completed: 원문 일치. 회사를 추천(recommended), 진척이 없고(progress), 완료 약속(completed) ← 정답
❌ ② criticized — progress — completed: (A) criticized(비판했다)는 recommended(추천했다)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ③ recommended — delay — completed: (B) delay(지연)는 progress(진척)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ④ recommended — progress — canceled: (C) canceled(취소된)는 completed(완료된)의 반의어로 부적절
det.tip: recommended your company(회사를 추천) / no progress(진척 없음) / completed one week prior(1주 전 완료)

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is (A)[scheduled / postponed] for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week (B)[after / prior] to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very (C)[concerned / relieved] about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① scheduled — prior — concerned: 원문 일치. 행사 예정(scheduled), 개막 전(prior), 매우 우려됨(concerned) ← 정답
❌ ② postponed — prior — concerned: (A) postponed(연기된)는 scheduled(예정된)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ③ scheduled — prior — relieved: (C) relieved(안심된)는 concerned(우려되는)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ④ scheduled — after — concerned: (B) after(이후)는 prior(이전에)의 반의어로 부적절
det.tip: is scheduled for March 3(3월 3일 예정) / one week prior to the opening(개막 1주 전) / very concerned(매우 우려됨)

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I (A)[confirm / question] whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you (B)[refuse / intend] to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will (C)[default / fulfill] on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① confirm — intend — default: (A) confirm(확인하다)는 question(의문을 품다)의 반의어로 부적절
✅ ② question — intend — default: 원문 일치. 이행 가능한지 의문(question), 완료 의향(intend), 불이행 경고(default) ← 정답
❌ ③ question — refuse — default: (B) refuse(거부하다)는 intend(의도하다)와 의미상 대립하여 부적절
❌ ④ question — intend — fulfill: (C) fulfill(이행하다)는 default(불이행하다)의 반의어로 부적절
det.tip: I question whether(이행 가능한지 의문) / how you intend to(어떻게 의도하는지) / will default on this contract(계약 불이행)

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, ①<u>recommended</u> your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen ②<u>virtually</u> no ③<u>regression</u> on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work ④<u>completed</u> one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 진척이 없다는 맥락. regression(퇴보)이 아니라 progress(진척)가 원문
det.analysis:
❌ ① recommended — 원문 일치. 형제가 회사를 추천했다는 맥락에 적절
❌ ② virtually — 원문 일치. 사실상 진척이 없다는 맥락에 적절
✅ ③ regression — 원문은 progress(진척). regression(퇴보)으로 교체하면 의미가 왜곡됨 ← 정답
❌ ④ completed — 원문 일치. 작업 완료 약속 맥락에 적절
det.tip: no progress on the project = 프로젝트에 아무 진척이 없다. regression(퇴보)은 다른 의미

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our ①<u>advance</u> payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to ②<u>break</u> the terms of the contract, and I am very ③<u>concerned</u> about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you ④<u>intend</u> to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 계약 조건을 충족하다가 맥락에 맞음. break(위반하다)는 meet의 반의어
det.analysis:
❌ ① advance — 원문 일치. advance payment(선불 지불)는 맥락에 적절
✅ ② break — 원문은 meet(충족하다). meet the terms(조건을 충족하다)가 원문이며 break(어기다)는 의미가 반대로 부적절 ← 정답
❌ ③ concerned — 원문 일치. very concerned(매우 우려됨) 맥락에 적절
❌ ④ intend — 원문 일치. how you intend to complete(어떻게 완료할 의향인지) 맥락에 적절
det.tip: meet the terms of the contract = 계약 조건을 충족하다. break(어기다)로 바꾸면 의미가 바뀌어 부적절

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week ①<u>prior</u> to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the ②<u>terms</u> of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work ③<u>on time</u>. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take ④<u>delayed</u> measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 계약 불이행 시 즉각적인 조치를 취함. delayed(지연된)는 immediate의 반의어
det.analysis:
❌ ① prior — 원문 일치. one week prior to the opening(개막 1주 전) 맥락에 적절
❌ ② terms — 원문 일치. the terms of the contract(계약 조건) 맥락에 적절
❌ ③ on time — 원문 일치. complete the work on time(제때 완료) 맥락에 적절
✅ ④ delayed — 원문은 immediate(즉각적인). 계약 불이행 시 즉각 조치가 필요하므로 delayed(지연된)는 부적절 ← 정답
det.tip: take immediate measure to protect ourselves = 자신을 보호하기 위한 즉각적 조치. delayed(지연된)는 urgent 맥락과 모순

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, __________ your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① recommended — My brother recommended your company(형제가 회사를 추천)로 자연스러운 도입 ← 정답
❌ ② scheduled — 예정하다. 주어가 형제이므로 회사를 '예정했다'는 표현은 부적절
❌ ③ completed — 완료했다. 형제가 회사를 '완료했다'는 표현은 비문
❌ ④ enclosed — 동봉했다. 추천 행위와 전혀 다른 의미
det.tip: recommended your company as one that would do a good job = 좋은 일을 할 회사로 추천

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will __________ on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① complete — 완료는 의뢰인이 바라는 것. 경고 맥락과 반대
✅ ② default — If it appears that you will default on this contract = 계약 불이행 시 즉각 조치 ← 정답
❌ ③ sign — 이미 계약 체결된 상황으로 sign은 불필요
❌ ④ extend — 계약 연장은 다른 협의가 필요하며 즉각 조치와 모순
det.tip: default on a contract = 계약을 불이행하다. 경고성 편지의 핵심 표현

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our __________ payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① advance — With our advance payment(선불 지급을 통해) 계약 이행을 약속받은 맥락 ← 정답
❌ ② immediate — 즉각적인. immediate payment(즉각 지불)는 의미가 다름. 선불 계약 맥락에서 부적절
❌ ③ prior — 이전의. prior payment(이전 지불)는 advance와 뉘앙스가 다르며 문맥상 어색
❌ ④ scheduled — 예정된. scheduled payment(예정 지불)는 선불(미리 지급)의 의미를 담지 못함
det.tip: advance payment = 선불금. 이미 돈을 냈음을 강조하여 이행을 촉구하는 맥락

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen <u>virtually</u> no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 virtually의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① rarely — 드물게 (빈도 표현, virtually와 의미 다름)
✅ ② practically — 사실상. practically no progress = virtually no progress (동의어) ← 정답
❌ ③ gradually — 점차적으로 (방식 부사, 동의어 아님)
❌ ④ occasionally — 가끔 (빈도 표현, virtually와 의미 다름)
det.tip: virtually = practically = 사실상, 거의. no progress가 수식되는 맥락에서 사실상 전혀 없다는 의미

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week <u>prior</u> to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 prior의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① previous — 이전의. prior to = previous to (동의어) ← 정답
❌ ② equal — 동등한 (관계 형용사, 동의어 아님)
❌ ③ subsequent — 이후의 (반의어)
❌ ④ critical — 중요한/비판적인 (prior의 동의어 아님)
det.tip: prior to the opening = previous to the opening = 개막 이전에. 시간 순서를 나타내는 표현

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very <u>concerned</u> about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 concerned의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① confident — 확신하는 (반의어 계열)
❌ ② excited — 흥분된 (긍정적 감정, 동의어 아님)
✅ ③ worried — 걱정하는. concerned = worried (동의어). 행사 준비에 우려되는 맥락 ← 정답
❌ ④ relieved — 안도하는 (반의어)
det.tip: very concerned about being ready = 준비에 대해 매우 걱정됨. concerned = worried = anxious

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy <u>enclosed</u>). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 enclosed의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① attached — 첨부된 (동의어)
❌ ② included — 포함된 (동의어 계열)
❌ ③ filed — 보관된/제출된 (enclosed와 연관된 표현)
✅ ④ omitted — 생략된/제외된. enclosed(동봉된)의 반의어로 포함되지 않은 의미 ← 정답
det.tip: contract copy enclosed = 계약서 사본 동봉. omitted(생략된)는 포함되지 않았다는 반의 의미

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will <u>default</u> on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 default의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① violate — 위반하다 (유사어)
❌ ② fail — 실패하다 (유사어)
✅ ③ fulfill — 이행하다/완수하다. default on a contract(계약 불이행)의 정확한 반의어 ← 정답
❌ ④ overlook — 간과하다 (관련 있는 표현)
det.tip: default = 계약/의무를 불이행하다. fulfill = 이행하다/완수하다. 법률/계약 어휘 대비

questions.passage:
(A) I question whether you will be able to meet the <u>terms</u> of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference.
(B) We need to reach an agreement on the <u>terms</u> of payment before we proceed with the deal.
questions.stem: 다음 두 문장에서 밑줄 친 terms가 사용된 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① 단어, 용어 — terms of contract/payment에서 단어 의미는 부적절
❌ ② 기간, 임기 — school terms처럼 사용될 때의 의미. 두 문장 맥락에서 부적절
❌ ③ 관계, 사이 — on good terms처럼 사용. 두 문장 맥락에서 부적절
✅ ④ 조건, 규정 — (A) meet the terms of the contract(계약 조건 충족), (B) terms of payment(지불 조건). 둘 다 계약/거래의 조건 의미 ← 정답
det.tip: terms of contract / terms of payment = 계약 조건 / 지불 조건. 비즈니스 맥락에서 terms = conditions(조건)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a formal agreement between two or more parties that is legally binding"

det.korean: contract = 계약(서). 두 당사자 간 법적 구속력 있는 공식 합의
det.analysis:
❌ ① payment — 지불/납부. 법적 구속력 있는 공식 합의 정의에 맞지 않음
❌ ② conference — 회의/콘퍼런스. 정의에 맞지 않음
✅ ③ contract — 계약(서). a formal agreement that is legally binding = 계약의 정의에 정확히 부합 ← 정답
❌ ④ progress — 진척/발전. 합의 의미가 없음
det.tip: contract = 법적 구속력 있는 공식 합의. 본문에서 contract copy(계약서 사본)로 사용됨

questions.passage: Our conference is __________ (schedule) for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 수동태 be scheduled for = 예정되어 있다
det.analysis: schedule → scheduled (수동태 과거분사). is scheduled for = ~로 예정되어 있다
det.tip: be scheduled for + 날짜 = ~로 예정되다. 수동태 구조에서 과거분사 형태 필요

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, __________ (recommend) your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 과거 시제 동사. 형제가 과거에 추천했다는 맥락
det.analysis: recommend → recommended (과거 시제). 과거 사실로 형제가 회사를 추천했음
det.tip: recommended = recommend의 과거형. 편지 맥락에서 과거 추천 사실 서술

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and __________, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 전화 통화 외에 서면으로도 후속 조치를 취하다는 맥락
det.analysis:
❌ ① complete the work — 작업 완료는 수신자에게 요청하는 사항이지, 이 빈칸의 행위와 다름
❌ ② meet the terms — 계약 조건 충족은 앞에서 의문을 제기한 내용. 빈칸 자리의 추가 요청과 다름
❌ ③ call me — 전화하는 행위는 앞 절(Please call me)에 이미 명시됨. 중복으로 부적절
✅ ④ follow up in writing — Please call me, and follow up in writing = 전화 + 서면 후속 조치 이중 요청 ← 정답
det.tip: follow up in writing = 서면으로 후속 조치를 취하다. 계약 관련 공식 소통에서 서면 기록 요구

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 계약 불이행 시 자신을 보호하다는 맥락
det.analysis:
❌ ① complete the work — 작업 완료는 의뢰인이 원하는 바이나, 불이행 조치의 내용과 다름
✅ ② protect ourselves — 원문 일치. take immediate measure to protect ourselves = 자신을 보호하기 위한 즉각 조치 ← 정답
❌ ③ meet the terms — 조건 충족은 수신자 측이 해야 할 일. 의뢰인의 자기보호 조치와 다름
❌ ④ default on this contract — 계약 불이행은 수신자가 할 경우를 전제한 조건절. 의뢰인이 하는 행위로 부적절
det.tip: protect ourselves = 법적/실질적 자기보호 조치. 계약 불이행에 대한 강경 대응 의지 표현
